mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (historical median) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed Fed rate cuts and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 3.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and FEDFUNDS stability signal labor market strength driving inflation expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The combination of PAYEMS rising and FEDFUNDS stable fails to produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 1200 thousand units signals housing market recovery, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1200 thousand units fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE declining below 3.8% signals labor market tightness, triggering wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 3.8% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous INDPRO growth and GDPC1 contraction signal supply shock disruption, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The combination of INDPRO rising and GDPC1 falling does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 4.0% during monetary tightening cycles increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 4.0% fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
